# A stationary-state receiver for a full logical qubit

29 October2026. Root construction, under active independent peer challenge.
This is a conditional quantum-information receiver. It does not itself prove
the static quantum Peierls estimate, generator locality, a microscopic bath,
or efficient physical encoding. The proof uses ordinary CPTP contraction,
logical Pauli twirling and Gibbs calculus; historical novelty is UNKNOWN.

## 1. Exact algebra and positive encoding

Let H be finite dimensional. Supply Hermitian unitaries O_X,O_Z with
O_X O_Z=-O_Z O_X and let O_Y=i O_X O_Z. This is an exact M2 algebra, hence
there is a unitary identification U:H->C2 tensor K taking O_alpha to the
ordinary logical Pauli matrices tensor I. Supply a faithful density matrix rho.
Define the logical twirl

    sigma=(rho+sum_(alpha=X,Y,Z) O_alpha rho O_alpha)/4
         =U^dagger[(I2/2) tensor tau]U,
    tau=Tr_C2(U rho U^dagger).

The encoder and decoder are actual CPTP maps

    Enc(omega)=U^dagger[omega tensor tau]U,
    Dec(a)=Tr_K(U a U^dagger).

Thus Dec Enc=id exactly. No product form of rho itself is assumed. In a
stabilizer application these O_alpha must be the exact corrected logical
Paulis of ONE shared syndrome decoder. Their implementation and preparation
of tau are separate resource contracts; a mathematical map is not a native
initializer.

## 2. Stationarity gives a fidelity receiver without reversibility

Let T_t be any finite-dimensional CPTP semigroup, with T_t(rho)=rho. Write
L* for its Heisenberg generator and use the GNS norm

    ||A||_rho^2=Tr rho A^dagger A,
    epsilon=||sigma-rho||_1,
    delta_alpha=||L*(O_alpha)||_rho.

Unital complete positivity gives T_t*(A)^dagger T_t*(A)<=T_t*(A^dagger A).
Taking rho expectation and using stationarity proves GNS contraction. Hence

    ||T_t*(O_alpha)-O_alpha||_rho <= t delta_alpha.

For the decoded qubit channel Lambda_t=Dec T_t Enc, its entanglement fidelity
with the identity channel is the exact Pauli expression

    F_e(Lambda_t)=1/4 [1+sum_alpha Tr sigma O_alpha T_t*(O_alpha)].

||O_alpha T_t*(O_alpha)||<=1. Cauchy--Schwarz in the rho inner product then

# A nonempty exactly stationary quasilocal model class

29 October2026. Root source acquisition and derived receiver bounds. This
does not admit a microscopic Davies bath or a fixed finite-range truncation.
The static Peierls estimate and decoder-good bounds for the chosen support
radius remain separate active inputs.

## 1. The precise ordinary source

Chen--Kastoryano--Gilyen, arXiv:2311.09207v2, TheoremI.1 and Equations7--12,
80--82, acquired directly from the primary paper:
https://arxiv.org/html/2311.09207v2

Use its Gaussian version, not its separately approximated Metropolis weights.
For one Hermitian unitary one-site Pauli A and beta>0 put

    f(t)=exp(-t^2/beta^2)/sqrt(beta*sqrt(pi/2)),
    Ahat(omega)=(1/sqrt(2pi)) integral f(t)exp(-i omega t) A(t)dt,
    gamma(omega)=exp[-(beta omega+1)^2/2],
    A(t)=exp(iH_g t) A exp(-iH_g t).

The source gives a Hermitian coherent correction B_A with the double-time
kernel b1,b2 of its Eq11. The resulting

    L_A(rho)=-i[B_A,rho]+integral gamma(omega) D_Ahat(omega)(rho)domega

is EXACTLY stationary at rho_beta=e^(-beta H_g)/Z. Each one-seed instance
satisfies the source's normalization6. Sum these instances for the3n site
Paulis, and optionally add -i[H_g,rho], which also fixes rho_beta. This gives
a genuinely nontrivial exactly stationary generator at constant per-site
update rate. Its total local strength is O(n). This avoids mistaking the
source's globally normalized one-update clock for a physical parallel clock.
No uniqueness or rapid-mixing hypothesis is needed by the root receiver.

The source coherent correction is retained. Omitting B_A generally forfeits
exact stationarity for a noncommuting H_g. The algorithmic sampler is an
established operation; neither it nor detailed balance is claimed invented.

## 2. Integrated jump strength has no hidden dimension/frequency factor

Let a_beta=||f||_1/sqrt(2pi). The exact elementary integrals are

    a_beta^2=beta/sqrt(2pi),
    integral gamma(omega)domega=sqrt(2pi)/beta.

Thus ||Ahat(omega)||<=a_beta and

    integral gamma(omega)||Ahat(omega)||^2 domega <=1.            (1)

This directly pays the frequency-integrated operator-norm-square budget
needed for coherent-jump estimate(4) of PROOF.md. Operator Parseval alone
would not justify exchanging operator norm with the frequency integral.

## 1. Exact logical algebra really gives a positive encoder

Let X,Z be anticommuting Hermitian involutions. Choose an orthonormal basis
of the +1 eigenspace of Z and use its X-images for the -1 eigenspace. This
constructs a unitary U identifying the full space with C² tensor K, with X,Z
acting as the logical Pauli matrices. In particular the dimension is even;
this is an exact representation, not a claim about an arbitrary decoder's
adjoint. Set Y=iXZ.

For any faithful state rho, the Pauli average is

    sigma = (rho+XrhoX+YrhoY+ZrhoZ)/4
          = U†[(I/2) tensor tau]U,
    tau = Tr_L(UrhoU†).

Consequently Enc(omega)=U†(omega tensor tau)U and Dec=Tr_K composed with U
are CPTP, and Dec Enc=id. The state rho itself need not factor or commute
with the logical Paulis. A stabilizer implementation must supply one common
syndrome recovery inducing this exact algebra. Efficient preparation of tau,
physical encoding, and implementation of U do not follow.

## 2. The fidelity constant and its precise all-input conversion

Let T_t be a CPTP semigroup fixing rho. Unital Schwarz and stationarity give

    ||T_t*(A)||_rho² <= Tr rho T_t*(A†A) = ||A||_rho²,

where ||A||_rho²=Tr rho A†A. Integrating the generator therefore gives
||T_t*(O)-O||_rho <= t||L*(O)||_rho. No detailed balance is needed.

For Lambda=Dec T_t Enc, the exact maximally-mixed entanglement fidelity is

    Fe(I/2,Lambda) = [1+sum_O Tr sigma O T_t*(O)]/4,

where O ranges over X,Y,Z. This follows directly from the Pauli expansion of
